_comment: Terrain rules table, SPEC.md §3. Global, not per-map: map.json references these ids. moveCost null means impassable. cover is none | light | heavy. landing (SPEC.md §9), when present: bad costs a man landing there his first turn, wounds wounds him and puts him ashore on the nearest bank. All balance numbers live here, never in logic (CLAUDE.md rule 5).

canal.label: Canal
canal.notes: crossable only at bridge or lock

bridge.label: Bridge
bridge.notes: canal crossing; not in the SPEC §3 table, added at M1 so §3's crossable only at bridge/lock is expressible

lock.label: Lock
lock.notes: canal crossing on foot; same addition as bridge

depot.label: Fuel dump
depot.notes: drums, tanks and tarpaulins; the fuel dump objective stands on it (SPEC.md §7). Not in the §3 table: added at M5b

scrub.label: Scrub
scrub.notes: camel-thorn: light cover you can be seen in

dunes.label: Dunes
dunes.notes: soft sand; a crest hides what lies beyond it

wadi.label: Wadi
wadi.notes: a dry watercourse below the ground: the safe artery; rocks make a bad landing

wire.label: Wire
wire.notes: the perimeter wire: a full turn for a sapper to get through

pen.label: Pen
pen.notes: earth and sandbag walls round an aircraft; its charge point stands in it

aircraft.label: Aircraft
aircraft.notes: a parked aircraft; the objective stands on it
